verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a dedicated Raw Event Export API returning JSONL event data, a Query API for filtering/breaking down events, retrieving user profiles and event streams, and JQL for custom JavaScript-based queries, all via well-documented endpoints. This directly matches the developer story of running analytical queries and exporting raw event data through a documented API. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the export/query API in practice, and details on rate limits, pagination, or query performance at scale.
